exposure: Trial of labor after cesarean delivery (TOLAC)
Candidates for TOLAC group: 368 women who met the TOLAC inclusion criteria
Qualified Candidates for TOLAH group: 37 women who met the TOLAH inclusion criteria
outcome: Use of more than two types of uterotonic medications
cohort: 405 women who gave birth at Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Hospital between June 14, 2018, and September 24, 2021, including those eligible for TOLAH and TOLAC.
finding: The study found no uterine ruptures in women who underwent TOLAH, and while vaginal delivery was significantly less common in the TOLAH group, HIFU itself was not a risk factor for PPH.
